Heb jij een passie voor het oplossen van complexe problemen voor een uiteenlopende groep klanten? Wil je e-commerce bedrijven helpen groeien door het leveren van hoogwaardige technische ondersteuning? Dan is deze rol misschien wel iets voor jou!
Je maakt deel uit van onze internationale Support Afdeling, bestaande uit 5 teams die meer dan 9 markten wereldwijd ondersteunen. Binnen deze globale structuur werk je in onze Benelux & International inbox, waar je klanten ondersteunt in diverse markten waaronder Nederland, België, Frankrijk, Italië, het VK en daarbuiten.

Jouw Nederlandse taalvaardigheid is essentieel om een sterke ondersteuning te bieden aan onze Nederlandstalige klanten, terwijl je rol zich tevens uitstrekt over de bredere internationale scope.
Wij zijn een open-minded en hecht team van Support-professionals. Wij geloven dat Support niet alleen draait om het oplossen van problemen, maar om het klaarstomen van onze klanten voor succes, en dat doen we samen. We leren van elkaar, houden van eerlijke en directe communicatie en maken onderweg tijd voor plezier. Verwacht platte hiërarchie, ruimte voor jouw ideeën en een team dat altijd voor je klaarstaat!
Jouw functie
Channable helpt online retailers en bureaus bij het automatiseren en optimaliseren van hun product listings op kanalen zoals Amazon, Google, Meta, Cdiscount en meer. Als Technical Support Agent ben jij het eerste aanspreekpunt voor klanten met vragen of problemen over onze tool.
Momenteel ondersteunen we meer dan 2.500 marketingkanalen, waaronder vergelijkingssites, affiliate netwerken en marktplaatsen. Ons klantenbestand varieert van zelfstandige webshop eigenaren tot internationale merken en bureaus, elk met hun eigen unieke behoeften.
Geen ervaring met e-commerce tools zoals productfeeds of API’s? Geen probleem! Wij bieden een uitgebreid inwerktraject en training, zodat je snel en soepel aan de slag kunt.
Na de onboarding start je bij onze eerstelijns support. Je verwerkt inkomende tickets, stelt diagnoses, lost problemen zelf op of escaleert ze naar de tweedelijns support indien nodig. Na verloop van tijd draag je bij aan het delen van klant- en commerciële inzichten om ons product, onze werkprocessen en de algehele klantervaring te verbeteren.
Jouw belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden
Afhandelen van klant tickets (1e lijn) via e-mail en telefoon, voornamelijk in het Nederlands en Engels.
Oplossen van problemen gerelateerd aan productfeeds, API's en marktplaats integraties.
Eigenaarschap nemen van klantcases van begin tot eind, met duidelijke communicatie en grondige documentatie.
Samenwerken met tweedelijns support en andere teams om complexe cases op te lossen.
Patronen herkennen en klant- en commerciële inzichten delen om ons product en onze werkwijze te verbeteren.
Nauw samenwerken met commerciële teams om te zorgen dat relevante signalen worden gedeeld en opgevolgd.
Actief deelnemen aan team rituelen en bijdragen aan verbeteringen binnen het team en de afdeling.
Continu ontwikkelen van je productkennis en professionele vaardigheden, met de mogelijkheid om op termijn door te groeien naar meer gespecialiseerde support taken.
Jouw uitdagingen
Channable is een krachtige, flexibele tool met een breed scala aan functionaliteiten. Het meester maken van de tool en begrijpen hoe onze klanten deze gebruiken, is de sleutel tot het leveren van hoogwaardige ondersteuning.
Je communiceert met zowel technische als niet-technische gebruikers, dus het vermogen om je communicatiestijl aan te passen is essentieel. Je zult daarnaast moeten balanceren tussen snelheid, helderheid en klanttevredenheid, terwijl je van begin tot eind de regie behoudt.
Deze rol biedt ruimte om te groeien. Je kunt extra verantwoordelijkheden op je nemen, zoals het inwerken van nieuwe teamleden, specialiseren in een specifieke productcategorie, of bijdragen aan wereldwijde support initiatieven buiten de Benelux-markt.
Hoe succes eruitziet
Je reageert snel, duidelijk en empathisch, en behaalt consistent KPI's gericht op kwaliteit, efficiëntie en teamdoelen.
Je handelt inkomende problemen zelfverzekerd af en escaleert alleen wanneer dat nodig is.
Je bouwt een diepgaand begrip op van zowel de tool als de toepassingen van onze klanten.
Je deelt proactief inzichten, helpt collega's en draagt bij aan het leerproces van het team.
Je bent betrouwbaar, consistent en neemt de volle verantwoordelijkheid voor je werk.
Wie ben jij?
Je bent nieuwsgierig, analytisch ingesteld en kunt goed verbanden leggen. Je houdt van probleemoplossing en beschikt over sterke communicatieve vaardigheden. Je bent een teamspeler die opbloeit in een dynamische samenwerking, maar je bent ook gemotiveerd om zelfstandig te werken. Je bent er trots op om zowel klanten als collega’s te helpen slagen.
Je voelt je thuis in een flexibele, snel veranderende omgeving waarin je wordt aangemoedigd om ideeën aan te dragen en initiatief te nemen.

Uitstekende mondelinge en schriftelijke vaardigheden in het Engels en Nederlands op C2-niveau.
Je bent minimaal 4 dagen per week (32 uur) beschikbaar en kunt minstens 2 dagen per week aanwezig zijn op ons kantoor in Utrecht.
Eerdere ervaring met technische ondersteuning, bij voorkeur in de IT of e-commerce, is een pré.
Wie zijn wij?
Onderdeel zijn van ons team betekent werken met een divers en gezellig team van mensen die je vertrouwen en je onderweg helpen. Channable is in 2014 opgericht in het hart van Utrecht. Inmiddels zijn we een sterk team van 320+ diverse individuen met meer dan 40 nationaliteiten, en hebben we een gloednieuw en bruisend hoofdkantoor in Utrecht van waaruit we klanten over de hele wereld bedienen. Daarnaast werken we vanuit andere kantoren, waaronder New York City, Berlijn en Aarhus.
Werken bij Channable betekent dat je op zoek bent naar net iets meer dan zomaar een baan. We brengen graag tijd met elkaar door — of dat nu op kantoor is, in onze Channabar of in een van onze interne chats. We zijn ruimdenkend en nuchter. We zijn er supertrots op dat iedereen zijn eigen speciale 'spice' toevoegt aan de cultuur van Channable.

Hoe divers we ook zijn, we delen allemaal onze passie om te groeien, te helpen, eigenaarschap te nemen en samen een geweldig avontuur neer te zetten. Neem gerust een kijkje op onze Instagram , Facebook , of LinkedIn , en lees ook vooral ons Culture Playbook door.
Wat doen wij?
Channable is een snelgroeiend B2B SaaS-platform dat een volledig geïntegreerde oplossing biedt om je producten online te vermarkten. Wij stellen marketeers en online bedrijven in staat om hun marketing te beheren, op te schalen en te optimaliseren.
Wat bieden wij?
Het salaris op basis van 40 uur ligt tussen de bruto € 2.850 - € 2.950 per maand.
8% vakantiegeld – 8% van je jaarsalaris, dat samen met het salaris van mei wordt uitbetaald.
Jaarlijks L&D-budget van € 1.000 om te besteden aan alles wat je wilt leren. Je kunt hier optimaal gebruik van maken om je professioneel te ontwikkelen.
Sparen voor je oude dag – we hebben een regeling voor je oude dag die kan oplopen tot 5% van je maandinkomen, of je kunt kiezen voor een toeslag van +2,5% op je maandelijkse basissalaris.

Are you passionate about solving complex problems for a diverse range of customers? Do you want to help eCommerce businesses grow by delivering high-quality technical support? Then this role might be for you!
You’ll be joining our international Support department, which consists of 5 teams supporting 9+ markets worldwide. Within this global setup, you’ll work in our Benelux & International inbox, supporting customers across multiple markets including Netherlands, Belgium, France, Italy, the UK, and beyond. Your Dutch language skills are essential to ensure strong support coverage for our Dutch-speaking customers, while your role will extend across the broader international scope.
We’re an open-minded and collaborative team of Support professionals. We believe Support isn’t just about fixing problems, it’s about setting our customers up for success, and we do this together. We learn from each other, keep things honest and direct, and enjoy the occasional fun moment along the way. Expect flat hierarchies, room for your ideas, and a team that’s got your back!
Your job
Channable helps online retailers and agencies automate and optimize their product listings across channels like Amazon, Google, Meta, Cdiscount, and more. As a Technical Support Agent, you'll be the first point of contact for customers with questions or issues related to our tool.
We currently support over 2,500 marketing channels, including price comparison sites, affiliate networks, and marketplaces. Our customer base ranges from independent webshop owners to international brands and agencies, each with unique needs.
No prior experience with eCommerce tools like product feeds or APIs? No problem! We’ll provide extensive onboarding and training to get you fully up to speed.
Once onboarded, you’ll start on our first-line support, handling incoming tickets, diagnosing issues, resolving them when possible, or escalating to second-line support if needed. Over time, you’ll contribute by translating customer-facing materials and sharing customer and commercial insights to improve our product, workflows, and overall customer experience.

Handle customer tickets (1st line) via email and phone, primarily in Dutch and English.
Troubleshoot issues related to product feeds, APIs, and marketplace integrations.
Take ownership of customer cases end-to-end, ensuring clear communication and thorough documentation.
Collaborate with second-line support and other teams to resolve complex cases.
Contribute to in-tool translations and occasionally support localisation of customer-facing materials.
Identify patterns and share customer and commercial insights to improve our product and ways of working.
Work closely with commercial teams to ensure relevant signals are shared and followed up on.
Actively participate in team rituals and contribute to team and department improvements.
Continuously develop your product knowledge and professional skills, with opportunities to grow into more advanced support responsibilities over time.
Your challenges
Channable is a powerful, flexible tool with a wide range of features. Mastering the tool and understanding how our customers use it is key to delivering high-quality support.
You’ll be communicating with both technical and non-technical users, so your ability to adapt your communication style is essential. You'll also need to balance speed, clarity, and customer satisfaction while maintaining ownership from start to finish.
This role offers room to grow. You can take on additional responsibilities, like onboarding new team members, becoming a product area specialist, or supporting global support initiatives beyond the French market.
What success looks like
You respond quickly, clearly, and empathetically, consistently meeting KPIs focused on quality, efficiency, and team goals.
You confidently handle incoming issues and escalate only when necessary.
You develop a deep understanding of both the tool and our customers’ use cases.
You proactively share insights, help teammates, and contribute to team learning.
You are reliable, consistent, and take full ownership of your work.
Who are you?
You're curious, analytical, and great at connecting the dots. You enjoy problem solving and have strong communication skills. You're a team player who thrives in a collaborative environment, while also being self-motivated and capable of working independently. You take pride in helping both customers and colleagues succeed.
You thrive in a flexible, fast-moving environment where you're encouraged to bring ideas to the table and take initiative.

You’re available for at least 4 days/week (32 hours) and can join us in our Utrecht office at least 2 days/week.
Any earlier experience with technical support, preferably in IT or eCommerce, is nice to have.
Who are we?
Being part of our team means working with diverse and fun people who trust and help you along the way. Channable was founded in 2014 in the heart of Utrecht. We are now a strong team of 320+ diverse individuals, more than +40 nationalities, and a brand new and vibrant HQ in Utrecht, serving customers all over the globe. We're also operating from other offices including New York City, Berlin, and Aarhus.
Joining Channable means you’re looking for a bit more than just a job. We like spending time with each other. Be that in the office, our Channabar, or in one of our internal chats. We’re open-minded and down-to-earth people. We’re super proud that everyone adds their own special spice to Channable’s culture.

Diverse as we are, we all share our love for growth, to help, to take ownership, and create an awesome journey together. Feel free to take a further look at our Instagram , Facebook or LinkedIn ! Give our Culture Playbook a read.
What do we do?
Channable is a fast-growing B2B SaaS platform that offers a fully integrated way to market your products online. We empower marketers and online businesses to manage, scale, and optimize their marketing.

About Halter
At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences.

Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance.

Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard.
We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund , Bessemer Venture Partners , BOND, DCVC , Blackbird , Promus Ventures , Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures .
To find out more, visit our LinkedIn & Instagram .

We’re looking for an epic Customer Support Specialist to join our Auckland HQ team. Support at Halter isn’t a call centre. It’s a team of problem-solvers who understand our farmers, our product, and how everything connects.

We’re the glue between customers and every part of the business - from field teams to product, engineering, and operations.We work both reactively and proactively, jumping in fast when something’s not right, and reaching out when farmers just need a hand or some guidance.

When someone gets in touch, you’ll take ownership from start to finish, listening, understanding what’s needed, and working with teams across Halter to drive the best outcomes on farm.

You show up every day ready to make a difference - for farmers, their animals, and your team.This role offers the opportunity to build a deep understanding of Halter’s products and customers, with pathways for career growth across the company.

s.h: What your day could look like
s.t:
Talking directly with farmers through chat, email, and phone - understanding what’s happening on farm and helping them get things back on track fast
Troubleshooting issues and using data, tools, and your own judgment to solve problems that matter
Spotting patterns and raising insights that help us improve how Halter works for farmers and animals

There’s a reason you visit your friends in person, live with your family and don’t do dinners over Zoom. Humans are wired for connection. We believe a world-class, in-person office culture is the best way for high-performing teams. Being office first is a core pillar of our culture.

Our office vibe is something special, it’s hard to describe until you’re here, but people at Halter who have come from fully remote or hybrid companies say they could never go back - the high energy and spectacular people they are now surrounded by everyday makes work so enjoyable.

s.h: Why our team loves working at Halter
s.t:
Work that genuinely matters. Every now and again a company comes along that transforms an entire industry and leaves the world in a better place. Our team gets to be part of something truly meaningful, helping farmers improve their livelihoods, spend more time with their families, and build more sustainable operations.
Spectacular people solving hard problems. Our culture is designed for talented people to do work that changes lives. The team is filled with diverse, kind, and driven people who push each other to do their best work. You'll be thrown into the deep end, tackling complex challenges and building something tangible that solves real problems.
You'll grow here. Autonomy, mastery, and learning define how we work. You'll have the freedom to work on interesting problems, master new skills, and continuously develop yourself, both through your role and our $1,000 personal growth fund.
This isn't easy, and we love that it's hard. Working at Halter will be the most rewarding and the most challenging work of your life. We move fast, take bold bets, and work hard to reshape an entire industry. As one team member put it: "Joining Halter is a bit like strapping yourself to a rocket ship, but it's an epic journey to be a part of!"

OpenAI’s User Operations team ensures that our customers’ experience is nothing short of exceptional. We resolve complex issues, provide guidance, and support customers in maximizing value with our products.
Within User Operations, Ads Safety Operations helps OpenAI grow advertising in a way that is safe, trusted, and sustainable for advertisers, users and the business. The Ads Safety Support team sits within Ads Safety Operations and owns the advertiser-facing support journey: helping advertisers navigate ads products, policies, reviews, and enforcement decisions while turning frontline insights into better guidance, tooling, and product experiences.

We’re looking for a Senior Advertiser Support Specialist to help build and scale advertiser support within Ads Safety Operations. You’ll work directly with advertisers through support tickets, escalations, owning high-impact questions related to ads policies, review outcomes, product behavior, and operational processes. Many cases will be novel or ambiguous, and you’ll be expected to investigate carefully, communicate clearly, and drive them to resolution in a fast-moving product environment.
As OpenAI’s advertising ecosystem grows, your work will help advertisers operate successfully at scale while serving as a critical bridge between frontline support and the teams responsible for product quality, policy integrity, and platform safety.

Beyond resolving individual cases, you’ll help define what world-class support looks like in an AI-native environment. You’ll turn support interactions into operational intelligence, identifying recurring friction, gaps in guidance, and emerging issues to improve support at scale, and protect the quality and safety of OpenAI’s ad ecosystem.

You’ll partner closely with Engineering, Product, Policy, Legal and Go To Market partners to improve systems, reduce bugs, and elevate the customer experience, while leveraging automation, agents, and our own AI technology to transform how support operates at scale.

Own advertiser cases from initial intake through resolution, including complex or sensitive Ads Trust & Safety escalations; investigate whether issues stem from policy, review operations, product behavior, tooling, or another dependency, then communicate clear next steps and follow through.
Develop deep expertise across advertiser workflows, ads policies, enforcement processes, review systems, and support tooling.
Build a detailed view of advertiser friction by combining ticket themes, escalation patterns, quality findings, and service metrics to prioritize improvements and identify emerging experience or safety gaps.
Turn frontline learnings into clearer help content, stronger playbooks, better routing and escalation criteria, improved knowledge management and quality standards, and self-service opportunities.
Partner with Product, Policy, Engineering, Legal, Data Science, and Go To Market teams to resolve recurring issues, surface advertiser feedback, and scale durable solutions.
Drive operational excellence through AI-assisted workflows and automation that reduce manual effort, improve team efficiency, and elevate support quality.
Support readiness for new ads formats, features, and markets by anticipating advertiser questions and identifying support risks early.
Providing occasional holiday and weekend support on call coverage, as needed, to support business and customer needs.

s.t:

Bring strong investigative judgment and can translate ambiguous signals into policy support, operational gaps, product defects, and expected behavior
Can synthesize data trends, feedback, QA findings, and service metrics into clear priorities and system improvement while maintaining strong judgment and safeguards
Have improved support processes, knowledge bases, escalation workflows, routing systems, or quality programs.
Are comfortable using AI and emerging technologies (i.e. Codex, ChatGPT, OpenAI API, etc.) and/or code (e.g. Python) to automate repetitive tasks and integrating tools
Build trust with cross-functional partners, communicate clearly and empathetically with advertisers and internal teams, and drive action without formal authority.
Thrive in ambiguity, learn quickly, manage competing priorities, and bring a humble, service-oriented mindset.
Bonus: Understand advertiser workflows, ads ecosystems, policy enforcement, account reviews, or ads safety operations.

Astra is building mission-critical infrastructure for moving money at scale. Our platform processes billions in annual transaction volume with 99.9%+ uptime, powering real-time transfers, bank debits, card disbursements, and complex financial compliance systems. We provide APIs and automation tools that enable businesses to move money programmatically while maintaining strict regulatory requirements.

We're looking for an API Support Specialist to join our Integrations team as we scale our payments API platform. You will be a front-line problem solver for our customers and their end-users.

This person will manage inbound support tickets — including tickets submitted by clients on behalf of their own end-users — troubleshoot integration and payment issues, and provide clear, timely resolutions.

The role requires strong problem-solving instincts, comfort with technical systems, and the ability to translate complex issues into clear solutions for customers.
You'll be the accessible, always-on technical resource for any client on our platform, regardless of account size — the person who makes sure issues get resolved fast and consistently, and who knows exactly when something needs to go to a specialist instead.

Own and resolve inbound technical support tickets across our full client base — API errors, integration questions, configuration issues, transaction discrepancies, and similar day-to-day technical problems
Meet defined response and resolution SLAs, prioritizing by severity and client impact
Triage incoming issues and make clear escalation calls — routing account-specific complexity to the appropriate Technical Account Manager, and any suspected platform-wide or systemic issues to engineering
Maintain and grow our internal knowledge base and runbooks, documenting resolutions so recurring issues get solved faster (or become self-serve) over time
Monitor ticket trends to spot patterns — flagging when the same issue is showing up across multiple unrelated clients, which often signals a systemic problem worth raising upstream
Communicate clearly and professionally with clients' technical teams, translating technical detail into plain, actionable guidance
Contribute feedback on recurring pain points to help inform product and documentation improvements
Help build the support function itself: as an early team member, you'll shape our macros, escalation paths, SLAs, and internal playbooks rather than just follow existing ones.

1-3 years' experience in a technical support, API support, or technical customer-facing role, ideally in fintech, payments, or another API-first product
Comfort reading API documentation, logs, and error responses, and troubleshooting integration issues methodically
Familiarity with REST APIs, webhooks, and common authentication patterns (API keys, OAuth)
Strong written communication — able to explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
Ability to prioritize under pressure across multiple open tickets with different urgency levels
A structured, checklist-minded approach to troubleshooting, paired with good judgment about when a problem is outside your depth and needs to be escalated

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

The Global Service Delivery (GSD) team is responsible for Agoda’s office infrastructure and staff connectivity, providing the hardware, software, and system access that enable employees to work efficiently across our global offices. Operating across multiple countries, the team delivers reliable support to Agoda employees whether they are in the office, working remotely, or traveling.
Within GSD, the People Technology (HR Tech) team manages the systems that power Agoda’s people operations. Our platforms, including Workday, support key HR processes such as employee lifecycle management, performance reviews, and organizational data, helping the company scale efficiently while improving employee experience.

Agoda is looking for a People Technology Functional Support Specialist to support and enhance our Workday environment following go-live implementation. This role is responsible for maintaining day-to-day system operations, troubleshooting issues, supporting business process improvements, managing configuration updates, and partnering with stakeholders across HR, Payroll, Finance, IT, and external vendors to ensure Workday continues to meet business needs.
The ideal candidate has experience in post-production Workday support, understands how to translate business requirements into scalable solutions, and is comfortable balancing operational stability with continuous improvement.

s.h: In This Role, You'll Get To
s.t:
Production Support & Issue Resolution
Provide day-to-day support for the Workday platform in a post-go-live environment.
Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve system issues, data discrepancies, security concerns, and process failures.
Monitor inbound tickets, production defects, integration errors, and end-user queries, ensuring timely resolution.
Triage issues and escalate to the appropriate internal teams or external partners when needed.
Support root cause analysis and recommend preventive solutions to reduce recurring issues.
Configuration & System Maintenance
Maintain and update Workday configuration based on business needs, policy changes, and compliance requirements.
Support changes to organizations, business processes, notifications, reports, calculated fields, eligibility rules, security roles, and validations.
Participate in regular system maintenance activities, including Workday releases, feature adoption, regression testing, and documentation updates.
Ensure changes are designed and deployed in alignment with governance and change control processes.
Business Process Optimization
Partner with stakeholders to identify opportunities to streamline and improve Workday-enabled processes.
Analyze current workflows and recommend enhancements to improve efficiency, user experience, compliance, and data quality.
Translate business requirements into functional designs and system changes.
Support continuous improvement initiatives following implementation stabilization.
Stakeholder Partnership
Act as a key liaison between HR, Payroll, Finance, IT, and other business teams for Workday-related needs.
Gather and clarify requirements for enhancements, fixes, and process changes.
Communicate system capabilities, constraints, risks, and recommended solutions clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Provide guidance to end users and stakeholders on Workday functionality and best practices.
Testing & Release Management
Coordinate and execute unit testing, system integration testing, and user acceptance testing for new enhancements and fixes.
Support Workday semiannual release reviews, impact assessments, and feature evaluations.
Maintain test scripts and ensure critical business processes are validated before deployment.
Partner with teams to ensure smooth production deployment and post-release support.
Reporting, Data, and Compliance
Assist in maintaining data integrity within Workday through audits, validations, and periodic review activities.
Support the development and maintenance of Workday reports, dashboards, and data extracts.
Ensure compliance with internal controls, audit requirements, and data governance standards.
Help monitor security access and support periodic access reviews as needed.
Documentation & Knowledge Management
Maintain functional documentation, configuration logs, SOPs, and knowledge articles.
Document business processes, issue resolutions, and change impacts clearly and accurately.
Contribute to training materials and support user enablement where required.

Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Information Systems, Business Administration, Finance, IT, or a related field.
Experience supporting Workday in a post-go-live or production environment.
Hands-on experience with one or more Workday modules such as HCM, Compensation, Absence, Time Tracking, Recruiting, Talent, Benefits, Payroll, or Security.
Strong understanding of Workday business processes, configuration concepts, and tenant management in a support model.
Experience gathering requirements, troubleshooting issues, and supporting system enhancements.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Experience supporting in both functional and technical workstreams in Workday

Workday certification(s) in relevant functional areas.
Experience working in a global or multi-country environment.

Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

We are seeking a dedicated and enthusiastic candidate to provide exceptional Customer Service support to the Airbnb community as a Senior Support Specialist, Premium Support . The ideal candidate is flexible, hospitable, analytical, and committed to delivering the highest standards of service in English and Spanish, spoken and written. This is a full time position based in Nevada, USA - remote.
The Senior Support Specialist, Premium Support functions on the front line interacting directly with both customers & internal stakeholders.

As a Senior Support Specialist, Premium Support , you will primarily be responsible for providing end-to-end support to key members of our community experiencing an issue with their reservation, including but not limited to the Luxury segment.

You will take ownership of cases, ensuring complete resolution while fostering strong relationships with our users along the way.
A Senior Support Specialist, Premium Support needs strong communication skills, problem-solving abilities, and customer service expertise. They will be expected to work in strong autonomy, being able to assess a case & constantly looking for the right solution for both Host, Users and internal stakeholders.

As part of this role, you are required to be flexible and may be required to move to different teams within Community Support and/or take up different responsibilities from those set out below. The ideal candidate will be open to a role which will evolve based on business needs and will be flexible to meet those needs.

The responsibilities listed below are not exhaustive. Given the fast-moving nature of this work, the responsibilities set out below may change and additional duties may be assigned as needed.
Complex case management: Provide the highest level of service to our community in each and every case
Interact with Airbnb customers and community members through all current and future channels, both inside and outside of Airbnb tools
Take end-to-end ownership of all assigned cases: ensuring a complete final resolution is reached based on workflows, management guidelines & your own assessment of the case situation
Become a subject matter expert in Airbnb policies and procedures
Operate with little to no support from your leadership
Explain and simplify complex information, provide appropriate context, and address complex questions with confidence
Ability to negotiate & mediate between Host & Guest in resolving the issues at hand on high-stake & high-value reservations
Proactively anticipate users expectations regarding case resolution and work towards the best outcome for all parties involved, thinking outside the box & constantly looking for compromises
Combining efficiency with bespoke quality: Provide personalized and exceptional customer support to guests and Hosts, ensuring their unique needs and preferences are met with the highest level of care and attention
Resolve user issues quickly and to a high level of mutual satisfaction, considering specific context and circumstances
Ability to multitask and handle multiple issues at the same time with efficiency and speed
Ability to articulate a rationale and make decisions on when and how to make workflow exceptions
Personalize communications to users, demonstrating the highest hospitality standards
Participating in your team’s improvement: Leverage your functional operational knowledge to proactively support the team success
Provide insights about community experience and continuous improvement opportunities to your Management
Collaborate with management & leadership to identify process and policy inconsistencies and recommend improvements for the dedicated user segment
May support Management on initiatives as assigned, such as to drive performance improvements, supporting Management on consultations, acting as a subject matter expert, etc.
Willing to take on various tasks and responsibilities as needed (including moving teams) and showing openness to new challenges and a proactive approach to work.
Stakeholder engagement: You have gained the trust of internal & external stakeholders through effective relationship management and delivering results
Demonstrates a high degree of flexibility, approachability, and integrity when resolving sensitive/complex issues relying on management when in doubt
You are on-call to handle emergency situations in the evenings & weekends
Inspire a culture where quality is a core principle.

4+ years of relevant experience in multicultural customer service teams, preferably in the hospitality industry (experience with high-profile and influential clientele is preferred) and in a role making calls and handling customer/client contacts
Hospitality experience is a plus, in particular working for technology platforms. Prior experience using phone, messaging, or live chat to interact with users/customers is preferred.
Experience engaging with executive-level stakeholders to resolve conflicts in a detailed, effective and timely manner, and demonstrated ability to explain complex ideas simply and clearly.
Ability to work weekend days and public holidays, as well as early morning / evening shifts. Your schedule can change to meet business needs
Excellent verbal and written communication skills for providing exceptional customer service to guests/hosts & engage with stakeholders
Active listening skills
Empathy and patience in dealing with customers, especially in high-pressure situations
Strong organizational skills, including prioritization, multitasking, attention to detail, and meeting goals and commitments
Passion for delivering exceptional customer service and setting a high bar
Ability to thrive in an ambiguous, fast-paced, and complex environment, acting proactively to respond quickly and decisively
Able to assess risk accurately, understand level of urgency, exercise good judgment, and share the most pertinent information with stakeholders, including Executives

Capable of adjusting to evolving roles and job duties with openness and flexibility, as well as moving to a new team
Advanced computer skills, including Apple/Mac OS, Google Suite, and familiarity with CRM systems and the ability to quickly learn new tools
Fluency in English and Spanish, spoken and written is required.

Accounts Payable Analysts at Collibra are responsible for
Executing full-cycle AP operations with high precision across a complex global ecosystem of multiple entities and currencies.
Partnering with Procurement and Treasury to manage financial obligations while supporting AI-driven initiatives to enhance departmental efficiency.
Processing diverse international invoices by applying correct tax treatments (VAT/GST) and ensuring accurate GL coding and PO matching.
Driving process automation by resolving AI-flagged exceptions, monitoring error queues, and participating in user acceptance testing.
Managing global pay cycles to ensure timely vendor payments and precise month-end reconciliations in alignment with internal controls.
You have
A bachelor’s degree in finance or accounting, or at least 5 years of experience in a high-volume AP role.
Proven experience with NetSuite or comparable ERP systems, alongside tools like Zip, Navan, or Brex.
Intermediate proficiency in Excel, specifically utilizing VLOOKUPs and pivot tables for data analysis.
Familiarity with international banking requirements and various regional payment methods (ACH, SEPA, BACS).
Demonstrated ability to work within automated or AI-assisted financial workflows.
This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship.
You are
Possessing a proactive working style with a deep commitment to accuracy and meeting tight deadlines.
A collaborative team player who thrives in fast-paced environments and takes full ownership of independent tasks.
Customer-service focused, maintaining a positive attitude and strong interpersonal skills when resolving complex issues.
An adaptable learner interested in how emerging technologies and AI can optimize traditional accounting functions.
A strategic thinker who identifies systemic issues and proposes effective solutions for process improvement.

Within your first month, you will master the end-to-end P2P cycle and integrate with our core tools and AI initiatives.

Within your sixth month, you will achieve complete ownership of global AP functions and independently resolve AI exceptions.

We are looking for an ERP Functional Support Specialist – Finance (Business Central) to support Finance users across a growing international organisation.
The role focuses on functional support for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central , primarily across Finance processes including AP, AR, GL, Fixed Assets and taxes .
This is a functional rather than technical role. The successful candidate should first understand the business need and look for the right process, standard functionality or configuration before proposing technical solutions.
You will support an expanding multi-country Business Central environment, with a rollout planned across 50+ countries , and will have the opportunity to grow over time into a broader Functional Analyst role.

Provide L1/L2 functional support to Business Central Finance users.
Analyse user questions and incidents and identify whether issues relate to process, data, setup or system functionality.
Guide users towards the correct use of Business Central and standard Finance processes.
Support Finance areas including AP, AR, GL, Fixed Assets and taxes.
Take ownership of support requests through resolution or appropriate escalation.
Document solutions and contribute to self-service materials, knowledge bases, training documentation and support automation.
Support user onboarding and training.
Work with functional consultants and technical teams when deeper analysis or system changes are required.
Support the continued rollout and adoption of Business Central across multiple countries.
Identify recurring issues and opportunities to improve processes and user experience.

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Finance, Engineering, Information Systems or a related field .
Around 2 years of relevant ERP, application support or functional consulting experience .
Previous functional ERP support experience required. Hands-on experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central or Dynamics NAV is strongly preferred.
Good understanding of business processes; knowledge of Finance and accounting processes is highly desirable .
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Service-oriented mindset and confidence working directly with end users.
Ability to explain system functionality clearly and practically.
English C1 or above is mandatory.
Spanish is a strong plus.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic and international environment.
Strong willingness to learn, take ownership and grow into broader functional responsibilities.
What we value
We are looking for someone who is curious, pragmatic and user-focused.
“What is the user trying to achieve, and what is the simplest sustainable way to achieve it?”

Help make the world more hospitable
The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that’s just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we’re transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences.
You’ll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You’ll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you’ll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we’re building.
If you’re motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you’ll feel at home here.

Let's get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:
This role is the escalation point that keeps customer relationships with Mews intact. When hotels hit issues that go beyond standard support, the Senior Support Analyst is who they reach, and how that interaction lands shapes whether a customer stays, grows, or disengages from the platform. Hospitality runs around the clock, and Mews is committed to being genuinely there for every property that depends on us.
You'll own the complex cases that come through phone, email, chat, and video, across multiple channels and territories. You'll build real relationships with customer and partner contacts over time, contributing to roundtables and customer events as part of how Mews stays close to the hotels it serves. There's a clear development path here too, with routes into specialisation, team leadership, or closer involvement in shaping product feedback.
The support function at this level isn't reactive. When a customer runs into something the platform needs to handle better, the Senior Support Analyst is the person who connects that signal back to the teams who can act on it, and who ensures the knowledge the team builds stays current and usable.
What you would do
Handle complex customer cases via phone, email, chat, and video, resolving situations that go beyond standard support paths
Work consultatively with customers to improve how they use Mews, identifying adoption gaps and efficiency opportunities rather than just resolving individual tickets
Spot patterns across incoming cases and bring clear, documented signals to Product, R&D, and senior support
Use AI to identify case resolution patterns, build knowledge base content, and develop support approaches that your colleagues across the team can adopt
Critically evaluate AI-generated suggestions before applying them to customer situations, and share that judgment with colleagues as a practical part of how the team improves
AI Fluency Level 3: In this role, that means you've looked at how support work gets done, not just how you personally work, and you've used AI to redesign at least part of it. Whether that's how knowledge articles get written, how case patterns get surfaced, or how resolution frameworks get developed and distributed, you've built something that others now follow. And when AI gives you a suggestion in a support context, you evaluate it properly before it reaches a customer.
For more information on AI fluency at Mews, please refer to AI Fluency at Mews: A Comprehensive Guide for Candidates on Confluence.
What you would bring
Experience in a technical customer support role, ideally in SaaS or hospitality technology
Analytical skills strong enough to work through complex, escalated cases and identify the root issue without needing everything handed to you
Fluency in English and Gujarati (written and spoken), with clear and effective communication across all channels
Availability for shift work, including a regular rotation covering weekends and bank holidays
AI Fluency Level 3: you've redesigned elements of a support workflow using AI, built approaches that others follow, and you evaluate AI output critically before applying it

Background in hotel operations — understanding the environment your customers work in changes how you support them
Experience with Salesforce, Aircall, or comparable support tooling

Enterprise support at scale generates an enormous amount of signal: contact patterns, resolution paths, escalation triggers, knowledge gaps, agent workload. Most of it currently goes unused. The Senior Director of AI Strategy exists to change that.
This is a leadership role for someone who understands what AI and intelligent tooling can realistically do inside a support organization, and who knows how to put those capabilities to work for agents, leaders, and customers. You bring a practitioner's eye (you have used these tools, not just read about them) and an operator's discipline (you know the difference between an impressive demo and something that sticks in production).
You will own Toast's AI and analytics roadmap for Enterprise Care: defining the strategy, piloting and selecting tools, and embedding intelligence into how the team operates every day.

Define and own the AI and intelligence strategy for Enterprise Care, aligned to the Journey Ownership model and the organization's 6- and 12-month roadmap.
Pilot, evaluate, and recommend AI tools for agent-facing use cases: co-pilot and in-call assist, smart case routing, knowledge base article suggestions, escalation prediction, and automated SOP drafting.
Partner with the Enterprise Support Program Manager and internal Product and Engineering teams to move AI tooling from pilot to production, including integration with Salesforce, the KB platform, and ticketing systems.
Design the analytics framework that Enterprise Care runs on: a clear set of intelligence products (dashboards, signals, and periodic reports) that leaders and agents can act on without routing every question to a central data team.
Own the complexity intelligence layer: build or commission the tooling to classify enterprise contacts by complexity tier, identify high-effort accounts, and surface burnout signals from agent workload data.
Lead the evaluation of AI-readiness inside the organization: identify where data is clean enough to support AI use cases, where it is not, and what it would take to close that gap.
Translate AI capabilities into operational impact for Enterprise leadership: you can explain what an LLM-based co-pilot is actually doing, why it improves AHT, and what error rates mean for agent trust, without needing a technical co-presenter.
Stay current on the rapidly evolving landscape of AI tools for customer support and bring informed, opinionated recommendations rather than waiting for consensus.
Build the data and AI literacy of the Enterprise Care team over time, so adoption is durable and not dependent on a single person.

10 or more years of experience spanning customer support, customer success operations, or enterprise service delivery, with at least 2 years specifically working with AI or ML tools in a production support or CX environment.
Hands-on experience with AI-assisted support tools: you have worked with, not just evaluated, products like Salesforce Einstein, Glance, or equivalent, and you have a point of view on what actually works at the agent level.
Ability to work with data at an operational level: you can define a metric, query a dataset with analyst support, interpret a distribution, and communicate what it means without overstating precision.
Strong instincts about where AI genuinely helps in support workflows versus where it creates noise, hallucination risk, or agent distrust, and the credibility to make that call stick with skeptical stakeholders.
Experience partnering with Engineering or Data teams to get intelligence products built: you can write a clear spec, review an implementation, and give useful feedback without being an engineer.
Leadership presence: you can earn the trust of support agents who are concerned about AI replacing their work, and you can earn the confidence of executives who expect AI ROI to be real and measurable.
A track record of building things that got used, not just things that got built.

Attentive's customers use our platform to run digital and in-store marketing programs that are critical to the revenue of their brands, and they notice immediately when something is wrong. Support is where the product meets the customer under pressure. We are hiring a Director of Support to own how that experience is delivered: the leadership team, the operating model, the budget, and the service commitments we make to customers.
You’ll inherit a functioning support organization with a strong foundation: three support tiers, clearly defined standards, and established SLOs. We’re looking for a Support Operations leader with deep expertise in tooling and automation. AI is already deployed across deflection, agent assist, and quality management, while offshore partners support a growing share of operations.
The next chapter requires a leader who can define Support’s commitments, integrate its people and technology, and set the direction for the organization’s continued evolution.
Concretely, you’ll lead the Support management team across the US, UK, and Australia; define the operating model and quality bar; own the budget and capacity plan; design a premium support offering from the ground up; and serve as the decision-maker for the company and our customers when Support needs to make a call.
This is a strategic operator role. You won’t be building automations or working the queue, you’ll determine what Support is accountable for, what it should cost, and how it can scale without headcount growing in proportion to volume.
What You’ll Accomplish
Lead the management team. Manage Support Managers and the Team Lead structure across US, UK, and Australia. Hire, develop, and hold a high standard for the people who lead the team day to day.
Own the operating model. Set the target state for tier design (L1/L2/L3), what stays stateside versus offshore, regional coverage, and peak-period operations. Sequence the transition and hold the team to it.
Manage offshore and partner capacity. Decide what work is delivered by partner teams versus stateside, how the teams work together, and how quality and SLO parity are maintained across both. Run the partner performance cadence, with Revenue Strategy & Operations supporting contracting and vendor management.
Manage budget and capacity. Own the headcount model, BPO spend, and tooling spend. Build a cost and capacity model that ties staffing to volume and SLO attainment and is used for annual planning.
Set the quality bar. Own the KPI and SLO framework, the QA program, and performance standards by tier. Accountable for CSAT, SLO attainment, and resolution trends.
Own customer-facing commitments. Design and launch a premium/enterprise support offering with tier-based SLAs Support can consistently meet. Set scope boundaries with CS, Services, and Sales, and provide the paid or self-serve alternative when work falls outside scope.
Establish Support Engineering as a discipline. Define the leadership model, technical bar, career path, and relationship with Engineering for our Level 3 team.
Be the senior escalation point. For customers, CS leadership, and the executive team. Own the CS incident-management program at the program level.
Partner across the company. Product and Engineering on supportability and customer-driven roadmap input; CS and Services on scope and handoffs; Enablement and Product Marketing on self-serve and launch readiness.
Your Expertise
Experience leading a B2B SaaS support or CX organization through a meaningful change in how work is delivered—such as a tier redesign or transition to partner or offshore teams. You have been accountable for both the outcome and execution.
Several years of experience managing managers and developing strong leaders.
Experience managing a support budget and building capacity models that inform staffing decisions.
A track record of holding clear scope boundaries with internal stakeholders while offering workable alternatives.
Experience running support for a data- or integration-heavy product, where data discrepancies and integration failures are common issues. You don’t need to debug them, but you should be credible with the people who do.
Experience deploying AI in a support context, with a clear understanding of deflection quality, failure modes, and where humans need to remain in the loop. You will be accountable for the results; someone else will build the tools.
Experience working alongside a strong, technical operations leader and giving them the space to do their best work.

Martech, ecommerce, or analytics background.
Familiarity with Zendesk, Assembled, and Looker.
Designed or launched a premium or tiered support offering.
Follow-the-sun coverage experience across US, UK, and Australia.

The NYC Department of Environmental Protection (DEP) protects public health and the environment for over 8 million New Yorkers. We provide 1.1 billion gallons of high-quality drinking water daily, manage wastewater and stormwater, and regulate air, noise, and hazardous materials pollution. With nearly 6,000 employees, DEP operates the largest municipal water and wastewater utility in the U.S.

The Bureau of Wastewater Treatment (BWT) operates and maintains critical wastewater infrastructure across all five boroughs, including 14 Wastewater Resource Recovery Facilities, over 90 pumping systems, combined sewer overflow facilities, and more.

BWT is undergoing a digital transformation focused on four pillars: SCADA Support and Development, IT Support and Cybersecurity, Asset Management, and Application Development. This transformation aims to modernize operations and improve resilience, efficiency, and data-driven decision-making.
Under the supervision of the Section Chief of SCADA Support, the selected candidate will serve as a SCADA Support Specialist for the specified BWT wastewater Treatment facilities. The SCADA Support specialist will be the subject matter expert (SME) on the facilities' SCADA system and associated components such as network, security, backup, and data management.

s.h: Key Responsibilities will include but not limited to
s.t:
· Provide technical support for SCADA systems, including troubleshooting and problem resolution.
· Assist with the design, implementation, and maintenance of SCADA systems.
· Configure and test SCADA software and hardware to ensure proper functioning.
· Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify and resolve issues with SCADA systems.
· Oversee and provide day-to-day maintenance and support of all components related to the facilities’ OT environment.
· Responsible for the configuration, installation, support and maintenance for all monitoring and control equipment including, electronic sensing devices, Remote Terminal Units (RTUs), Programmable Logic
Controllers (PLCs), Human Machine Interfaces (HMI), data communications equipment and services, computer hardware, and other telemetry devices.
· Work with third party vendors/contractors to ensure proper installation, reliability, accuracy, and maintenance of all computer hardware and supporting control systems associated with Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) system.
· Work with field technicians and I.T. divisions to support operation and upgrades of the telemetry equipment and communications infrastructure.
· Coordinate with operating and maintenance personnel to provide for proper calibration, repair and maintenance of sensors, instruments, and telemetry equipment.
· Maintain the facility’s network devices, data backup, anti-virus, patch management, and PLC backup systems. Troubleshoot and resolve computer system issues (HW/SW).
· Maintain documentation of SCADA systems and processes.
· Apply and maintain local security and cyber-security protocols and standards establish by the I.T. management group.
· Travel to and support SCADA systems at other facilities as required.

1. A baccalaureate degree in computer science, engineering or a related field from an accredited college and four years of satisfactory full-time experience related to IT automation engineering, monitoring engineering, management of infrastructure; or
2. Eight years of satisfactory full-time experience related to IT automation engineering, monitoring engineering, management of infrastructure;
3. Education and/or experience which is equivalent to "1" or "2" above.
